brief:
[c1] Resorts World New York City has officially formed a joint venture with Cirrus to invest in this housing commitment, which will focus on large-scale projects across the five boroughs. The new partnership will begin to invest in new housing developments in the immediate term.
[c2] To meet this need, Resorts World has made a down payment to build fair housing in a multi-million-dollar commitment not just for its employees but all working-class New Yorkers.
[c3] Workforce Housing Fund
[c4] $25M Annually
[c5] $25M Delivered in 2026
[c6] Data as of September 2026

c13.title: https://rwnewyork.com/community/community-investments/workforce-housing/
c13.excerpt: About 700 new homes could be coming to Downtown Jamaica on the site of what’s now a massive parking garage, as part of the agreement by Resorts World New York City and Cirrus Real Estate Partners to deliver nearly 50,000 units across the five boroughs. The joint venture has purchased the 1.8-acre development site and parking garage at 92-30 165th St. for $46.1 million with plans to turn the lot into housing, according to Cirrus and Ripco Real Estate, which brokered the deal.
